articles.title: Payments platform Decta explores stablecoin-enabled treasury settlement
articles.snippet: Decta will use USDC through OpenPayd’s infrastructure for international treasury settlement, seeking faster transfers and more efficient liquidity management.

articles.title: White House vows to get CLARITY across ‘finish line’ in September
articles.snippet: Patrick Witt says the Trump administration will keep negotiating with Democrats as the Senate prepares for a September CLARITY vote.

articles.title: Thailand’s 0% crypto tax. Bitcoin Red Team forced to use Chinese AI: Asia Express
articles.snippet: The Bitcoin Red Team has been forced to rely on open source Chinese AI, after OpenAI restricted access. Thailand sets crypto tax to 0% in bid to become crypto hub.

articles.title: ‘Disappointing’: Crypto advocates react to delay in CLARITY vote
articles.snippet: Following a procedural delay in the US Senate, lawmakers are expected to address a major crypto market structure bill after they return from a month-long recess, which met with industry criticism.

articles.title: OpenAI's Only Dedicated Ethicist Has Left With No Replacement: FT
articles.snippet: Chloé Bakalar joined from Meta last August and departed in July without any announcement, one of several safety exits in recent weeks.
